messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for prod: streaming/function-calls — SSE disconnect spike + tool-call parse errors. Incident ID: INC-1923456789
Maria: I'm oncall, taking lead. joining...
Devon: joining. any initial impact numbers?
Maria: initial: ~1.2% streaming sessions failing, 3 customers showing aborted streams. customers-ids: cust-421, cust-987, cust-proto.
Ashok: pasting logs from router-03:
```
2026-03-14T22:12:59Z ERROR parser.go:213 parse_toolcall: unexpected token at byte 342, payload: <malformed-json: trailing-comma>
2026-03-14T22:12:59Z WARN streammgr.go:88 upstream disconnect: EOF
```
Sylvie: interesting — trailing comma in payload reported by logs. but parser should be tolerant. also seeing `Event: toolcall` messages arriving split across frames.
Raj: hypothesis-1: client chunking + trailing comma triggers strict JSON decoder to error, causing parser to close connection -> SSE disconnects.
Maria: hypothesis-2: ingress router started enforcing `strict-sse-parser=true` after last deploy (deploy 22:00). rolling back parser flag could mitigate.
Devon: can we flip `strict-sse-parser` to false for prod-router-*/region-us-west for quick mitigation?
Ashok: yes, command:
```
./adminctl set-config --service=ingress --key=strict-sse-parser --value=false --scope=prod-us-west
```
Ashok: doing it now, will roll to 20% then 100% if green.
IncidentBot: Change approved by oncall.
Maria: flipping now. monitoring logs + errors.
(2m later)
Maria: errors dropped from 1.2% -> 0.2% after 20% roll. continuing.
Sylvie: note: even with parser relaxed, malformed tool-call payloads still delivered as opaque events; some clients will still reconnect repeatedly — need longer-term fix.
Devon: mitigation checklist:
- [x] relax parser flag
- [x] route impacted customers to fallback endpoint (no toolcall parsing)
- [x] notify support & CS (queued)
- [ ] deploy tolerant parser library in next patch
- [ ] add incoming payload sanity checks + metric
Maria: handoff: I'll be on call another 30m then hand off to Devon. Devon will drive post-incident RCA and timeline.
Raj: building timeline below (raw):
- 22:00:00 deploy ingress v2.14 (includes stricter sse parser)
- 22:11:45 first toolcall parse_error spike in router-02
- 22:12:59 widespread parse errors and disconnects (INC-1923456789)
- 22:14:10 parser-flag relaxation initiated
- 22:16:40 error rate dropped to baseline
Ashok: storing raw bytes for 22:12:30-22:13:30 for affected sessions at s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1923456789/raw
Sylvie: hypotheses tracked:
1) strict parser + client chunking -> confirmed (good evidence: failing payloads show trailing commas and split events)
2) client library regression (iOS 1.4.2) -> investigating. we have two customers on that version.
3) upstream proxy dropped keepalives -> inconclusive
Devon: I'll start an action item list in the RCA doc: link https://redwood.share/rca/1923456789
Maria: notify CS that a small subset of streaming/toolcall customers may have seen aborted sessions; we've mitigated. /cc @support
SupportBot: Notified support rotation.
Raj: tagging followups: fix parser to accept trailing commas OR sanitize payloads at ingress; add more robust SSE framing tests; add metric `toolcall.parse.errors` per client-version.
Sylvie: adding test case for chunked `event: toolcall` split across frame boundary.
Maria: closing incident thread here — moving to postmortem. will update RCA link once Devon completes.
Devon: taking postmortem, will include timeline, logs, customer impact, followups. :thumbsup:
